description: Encrypt data (up to 32KB) using the current version of a KMS key. Only AES256 or RSA2048 key types supported.

context.description: Base64-encoded context for convergent encryption (required if key has convergent encryption enabled, max 50 bytes)

keyTag.description: Key tag - unique identifier derived from key name

plaintext.description: Base64-encoded plaintext data (string or array of strings, max 32KB each)

name: ncloud_kms_encrypt
